geminias:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent PNG videogame sprite sheet 1024x1536, exactly 8 columns x12 rows, 96 square cells 128x128, no drawn grid. Full-body consistent character centered each cell, fixed front three-quarter camera and scale, baseline 115 pixels into each cell, all effects inside cell. Transparent alpha, no background or floor shadows. NO text.
Character GEMINIAS: GOOGLE GEMINI AI ASSISTANT PERSONIFIED AS A CONTEMPORARY DIGITAL MASCOT. Absolutely NOT medieval fantasy. A cute mischievous sleek compact AI robot, glossy white smooth rounded body like a futuristic consumer electronics assistant, large luminous blue-to-violet FOUR POINT CONCAVE SPARKLE STAR shaped HEAD, face in the middle of the star with two expressive dark navy digital eyes and tiny smile, no helmet. Short rounded white arms and boots, translucent blue purple circuit seams, luminous four-point Gemini sparkle on chest. A pair of small blue and purple holographic chat windows beside hands express its multimodal thinking, icons only no text. Silhouette instantly evokes Gemini's blue purple sparkle symbol. Not a human in armor. Polished charming 3D toy mascot finish, clear modern AI identity, minimalist bright design, slightly cocky boss personality. No twin heads, no crown, no cape, no gold, no knights, no magic grimoire, no weapons.
Each ROW eight distinct sequential animation poses left-to-right; rows top-to-bottom:
1 normal idle breathing and blinking, star head gently rotates a few degrees.
2 normal hurt recoil and recover.
3 transformation white/cyan to overclocked violet, cyan circuits flare, star becomes intense violet-magenta.
4 overclocked idle.
5 overclocked hurt.
6 normal prepare, chat windows collapse into cyan pixel data orb in hand, last two frames fully charged.
7 normal attack, thrust hand launch cyan fourpoint digital star projectile then recover.
8 normal blocked, digital star breaks into square pixels, surprised face, recover.
9 overclocked prepare violet pixel orb.
10 overclocked violet star attack then recover.
11 overclocked blocked, violet pixels scatter, recover.
12 defeat: glitch, stagger, sit down, white body powers off and dissolves into blue pixels until final sparse pixels.
Every cell same exact modern robot anatomy and identity. Eight columns TWELVE rows with 128x128 cells. Keep 8px gutters. Consistent registration. Background fully transparent.
claudio:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity transparent PNG sprite atlas 1024x1536, exactly 8 columns x12 rows of square 128x128 cells (96 frames), no grid lines or labels. Fixed front-three-quarter camera, same character scale and feet baseline in every cell, full body ~98 pixels tall, centered with 8px safe gutters. True transparent background, NO floor or outside shadows.
CLAUDIO: CLAUDE AI PERSONIFIED AS A MODERN FRIENDLY BUT STUBBORN DIGITAL ASSISTANT MASCOT. Distinctive TERRACOTTA ORANGE asterisk/starburst HEAD: soft thick irregular radial rounded spokes like Claude's orange sunburst logo forming the actual head silhouette, NOT a halo behind a human head. Center of orange head has simple expressive dark dot eyes, gently thoughtful eyebrows, tiny smile. Compact off-white cream rounded ceramic robot body with burnt-orange accents and charcoal joints, soft cute hands, stubby boots. Terracotta radial asterisk emblem on chest unmistakably Claude. Two small floating cream digital DOCUMENT PANELS next to hands, dark gray abstract horizontal lines suggesting writing, no readable text. Orange stylus in right hand, like a tablet pen, NOT a feather quill. Modern AI writer/coder assistant, calm clever personality, contemporary minimalist collectible 3D toy rendering, matte clay and cream materials. No gold, crowns, robes, armor, masks, medieval objects, magic books, knights or Dark Souls aesthetics. The orange starburst IS its face/head, not a person wearing a costume.
Twelve rows top-to-bottom, eight incremental motion frames per row:
1 normal idle breathe, blink, slight thoughtful head tilt, document panels gently hover.
2 hurt, surprised eyes and recoil then recover.
3 overclock transformation orange circuits intensify to coral-red, starburst spokes gently expand and cream body gains warm coral seam lights.
4 overclocked idle.
5 overclocked hurt recover.
6 normal prepare: stylus taps document panels, orange digital asterisk packet gathers in hand, final two frames hold.
7 normal attack: swipe stylus to launch orange asterisk data packet, recover.
8 normal blocked: orange packet breaks into rectangular document fragments, annoyed face, recover.
9 overclocked prepare: coral digital packet charges.
10 overclocked attack: coral-red asterisk packet launched, recover.
11 overclocked blocked, coral packet becomes square pixels, recover.
12 defeated: stunned, slumps seated, orange face dims, cream body dissolves into orange square pixels, only scattered pixels in final frame.
Keep Claude's recognisable irregular radial terracotta starburst shape and very same body across all frames, coherent animation arcs. EXACT 2:3 sheet aspect ratio, 8 columns and 12 rows, fully transparent alpha background.
